verdict.rationale: Vanta's developer docs describe first-party webhooks: you register an HTTP endpoint, receive real-time notifications when events happen, verify Svix signatures, and handle retries instead of polling. That is registrable outbound HTTP callbacks a programmatic consumer can receive. The status-page email alerts are not webhooks and were not credited. Missing for 10: documented catalog of subscribable event types or filtering, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the webhooks work as described.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can subscribe to events via webhooks

citations.quote: Receive real-time HTTP notifications when events happen in Vanta — register an endpoint, verify Svix signatures, and handle retries — instead of polling the API.
